name: XDS
verdict: XDS is the bicycle brand of a Shenzhen-based Chinese manufacturer (Xidesheng), a private company; it is the team's title sponsor and bike supplier. Nothing found.
note: Rated none on 2026-10-01: sourced ownership claim shows a private Chinese manufacturer; no state in the ownership chain and no human-rights finding against the company found. XDS's premium line X-LAB supplies the team's bikes; the SPX marking on the 2026 jersey sleeve and shorts is a product-line marking of XDS itself, so it is not a separate sponsor.
